evidence.quote: July 27 (Reuters) - Nvidia is in talks to provide roughly $250 billion in financing guarantees for OpenAI as part of a massive data center project, the Wall Street Journal reported.
evidence.one_line: 路透社于2026年7月27日报道，援引《华尔街日报》称英伟达正在洽谈为OpenAI的数据中心项目提供约2500亿美元融资担保。
evidence.speaker: Reuters

evidence.quote: The deal underscores a broader ‌shift as tech giants increasingly tap debt and equity markets to fund AI infrastructure, with ​spending set to top $700 billion this year.
evidence.one_line: 路透社称，科技巨头通过债务和股权市场为AI基础设施融资的趋势扩大，相关支出预计在2026年超过7000亿美元。
evidence.speaker: Reuters
